description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the X509AuthHandler class within the org.eclipse.hono.adapter.mqtt package. It verifies the behavior of the handler when dealing with client SSL certificates, particularly focusing on failure scenarios and certificate validation. The class includes mock setup, test methods, and a custom X509Certificate implementation for testing purposes.

classes.name: X509AuthHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for X509AuthHandler, verifying its behavior under various SSL certificate validation scenarios. Contains setup and test methods, and a nested class for mock X509 certificates.

classes.name: EmptyCertificate
classes.description: A mock implementation of X509Certificate with minimal functionality, used to simulate certificates with specific subject and issuer data for testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating mock instances of X509Authentication and HonoClientBasedAuthProvider, and then instantiates the X509AuthHandler with these mocks.

methods.name: testHandleFailsWithStatusCodeFromAuthProvider
methods.description: Tests that the authentication handler correctly propagates a service invocation failure with a 503 status code when the validation of a client certificate fails with a ServerErrorException.

methods.name: EmptyCertificate (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs an EmptyCertificate with specified subject and issuer distinguished names.
